operation_details.item: The user's email program uses a weekly send cadence.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I’m reviewing the structure of an email program and want to document its operating model.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I can help organize the details into a concise operating summary covering the program structure, platform, segmentation, and cadence.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The program covers onboarding and re-engagement flows.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That gives the program two distinct lifecycle purposes: welcoming people and reconnecting with them. We can keep those flows clearly separated in the documentation.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The automation is built in Klaviyo.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: I’ll note Klaviyo as the automation platform and use platform-specific language only where it helps clarify the workflow.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The email list is segmented by behavior.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Behavior-based segmentation should be reflected in the flow logic and campaign planning, rather than treated as a single undifferentiated audience.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I also want the documentation to make the sending rhythm easy to find.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: That makes sense. I’ll place the cadence alongside the flow coverage, platform, and segmentation details.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: The email program I oversee uses a weekly send cadence.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The summary can now state that the program covers onboarding and re-engagement flows, runs in Klaviyo, uses behavior-based segmentation, and follows a weekly send cadence.
